name: Body Attributes
description: Allows adding classes and HTML attributes to the body and other tags based on configurable rules.
project_description: Body Attributes lets site builders add CSS classes and HTML attributes to page elements based on configurable rules with visibility conditions. Each rule is a 'body_attribute_rule' config entity that targets a zone (html, body, header, main, footer, or a custom CSS selector), sets either a class or a named HTML attribute plus its value, and optionally restricts where it applies by request path or node bundle. Rules for the html/body zones are merged into Drupal's html_attributes/attributes Attribute objects during hook_preprocess_html(); rules for other zones are applied client-side via a small JavaScript behavior fed through drupalSettings. Managed from Configuration > User Interface > Body Attributes and gated by the 'administer body attributes' permission.
